instruction.german: Read Alex’s diary. Then go to Exercise.

readingText.content:
Wednesday

I never have lunch at school, but this week is different. Mum and Dad are away. My friends say, ‘‘Welcome to the school canteen, Alex! Lunch is always delicious here.’’

‘‘So, what’s for lunch today?’’ I ask. The dinner lady comes and puts the food on our table. ‘‘There’s fish, rice and salad,’’ she says. I eat the fish and it’s OK. But the rice is cold and the salad ... well, it’s just one tomato! I say, ‘‘More fish, please?’’ ‘‘No,’’ the dinner lady says. ‘‘That’s all for today.’’


Thursday

It’s lunch at school again ... My friends and I sit at the table and wait. It’s twelve o’clock, but the food isn’t here. What’s happening?

Here’s the dinner lady, at last! It’s late and we’re hungry! ‘‘There’s pasta today,’’ she says. We look at the pasta and ... it’s just pasta – no tomato, no tuna ... After I eat it, I look at the dinner lady. I’m angry!


Friday

Hooray! It’s my last day at the school canteen. Here’s the dinner lady again. This time, she’s early. ‘‘Today is Friday,’’ she says. ‘‘So there are sausages and chips for lunch. You like sausages and chips.’’ ‘‘Yes!’’ we say. ‘‘Thank you!’’ The dinner lady puts the food in front of us. I’ve got one sausage and only five chips! But, no problem. After my friends and I finish the sausages and chips, I open my lunch box. I’ve got chicken sandwiches for everyone!
